name: S1 Finger Priority

items.name: Recruitment Pulls
items.variation: 5-8 efforts, 3-5 s, max intent, 2-3 min rest.

items.name: Primary finger method
items.variation: B1: Max Hangs MAW 20mm · B2: MED Hangs · B3: Max Hangs + Grip Specificity Block · B4: Max Hangs 3 sets only

items.name: Repeaters, plus 20 min moderate bouldering
items.variation: Replaces Limit Bouldering this block. Tissue and technique, not force expression.

block1Variation: No Limit Bouldering, no Recruitment Pulls. Item 4 becomes Repeaters plus 20 minutes of moderate bouldering. Block 1 is tissue and technique, not force expression.
preSession: Tendon Nutrition Timing 60 min before. 15 g gelatin or collagen with vitamin C.
stopRules: Grip position changing mid-hang: that set doesn't count. Two in a row ends the exercise.
Recruitment Pulls: stop when peak drops 5% below the session best.
Any finger pop, click, or sting: session over.
Palpation tenderness over a pulley found during warm-up: 25-30 mm and drop load 30% for the day, then read Tendon Health.
Shoulder sensation during Weighted Pulls: exercise over for the day.
shortOnTimeNote: Running out of time and doing the finger work last. With 60 minutes: warm-up, three sets of the primary finger method, Tension Circuit, go home. A short session with the priority intact beats a full session with the priority moved to the end.

name: S2 Limit Boulder

items.name: Universal warm-up, ending with two boulders 3-4 grades below limit
One near-limit boulder as potentiation, if it's a good day
Optional problem C, only if attempt quality is holding

preSession: Never on the same day as Recruitment Pulls at full intensity.
stopRules: Three consecutive attempts worse than the session best. Over, whatever the clock says.
Any fingertip hot spot. Over. Skin costs a week and the remaining attempts are low quality.
Any move that makes me think about my shoulder gets abandoned, not repeated.

name: S3 Power and Contact

items.name: Footwork Precision: two drills, drawn at random

block1Variation: Becomes a second S4 Volume and Skill with Contact Strength Ladder stage 2 added.
stopRules: Catch quality degrading (sloppy landings, uncontrolled swing) means the nervous system is done. Over regardless of reps remaining.
Recruitment Pulls: peak 5% below session best.
Shoulder pain: exercise over for the day. The painless positional click doesn't appear in catch work.
Any finger pop, click, or sting: session over.

name: S4 Volume and Skill

items.name: Footwork Precision: two drills, drawn at random

stopRules: Skin: if Monday left me at 2/5 on the Skin Programme scale, do mobility and drills and skip the volume climbing. Skin is the binding constraint on Friday and Tuesday isn't worth spending it on.
Any finger stiffness on waking: replace item 3 with an extra 20 minutes of items 4-6.
intensityCeiling: Nothing above two grades below my limit. If I'm trying hard, the session has become something else and Monday will suffer.
filming: One boulder per session, side-on. Trace the hip path that evening.

items.name: Warm up
items.variation: The walk in is not the warm-up.

items.name: Brush the crux holds
items.variation: Highest-return thing I'll do all day

items.name: Full warm-up: easy traverses, three easy boulders, progressive hangs on a portable edge
items.variation: Don't skip on a cold day

items.name: Beta Lab if this is session 1 on the boulder
Visualization Protocol, one real-time rehearsal per real attempt
items.variation: In position, chalked, not weighting the holds

items.name: Stop when the rules say stop

preSession: Conditions Forecasting check: dew point forecast, rock temperature and aspect, wind, go/no-go. Skin Programme assessment (below 3, go anyway but budget fewer attempts). Pack two pairs of shoes, brush, infrared thermometer, fan if humid, frozen bottle if hot. Nine hours in bed (Sleep Protocol). Write the attempt budget down: six to ten genuine, decided now, not at the boulder.
stopRules: Three consecutive declining attempts.
Any fingertip hot spot. Skin costs a week.
Any shoulder sensation on a move: abandon that beta, don't repeat it.
Conditions collapsing: dew point rising into the rock temperature. Go home. A wet hold isn't a strength problem.
attemptDisciplineRules: Timer. Three minutes minimum, five on the crux. At 60 seconds I'm at ~85% of phosphagen capacity and an 85% attempt is wasted.
Fixed attempt budget, written down before the session.
Stop after three consecutive attempts worse than the day's best.
Log every attempt: number, highest point, genuine or rehearsal, one clause on the failure mode.

stopRules: Shoulder pain in any item: that exercise over for the day. The painless click in item 4 is expected and gets logged 0-3, not stopped.
Click getting louder or appearing at lower loads across consecutive weeks in item 4: regress a stage.
Asymmetry over 20% between sides in item 6: work the weak side only.
Medial elbow tenderness: cut item 5 load 20%, double Antagonist and Wrist on Saturday.
Skin at 2/5 from Monday: do items 1, 4-8 and skip the wall climbing. Friday matters more.
Any finger stiffness on waking: items 4-8 only.
shortOnTimeNote: 121 min at the top end. Trim item 3 to 15 min and item 8 to Thursday to make ~100.
intensityCeiling: Items 2 and 3 stay at or below two grades under my limit. Still a skill day with a strength block attached, not a hard session.
